briefing: 今日导读：Meta推出AI游戏开发工具和AI助手Muse，标志着它在AI领域的持续创新。谷歌的Project Suncatcher欲将ML基础设施送入太空，展示了AI技术应用在新的极限环境下。值得注意的是，美国的AI投资达历史高峰，反映出全球对人工智能的关注和重视。
highlights: 今日看点：Meta和谷歌的最新举措显示出AI技术的扩展潜力。Meta的AI游戏开发工具和AI助手展示了AI在内容创造和日常辅助领域的前景。另一方面，谷歌计划将AI基础设施送入太空，以测试其在极端环境下的性能，这标志着AI技术应用领域的进一步拓展。此外，美国AI投资达到历史高峰，表明全球范围内AI技术和基础设施的优先布局已刻不容缓。

events.title: Meta 推出 AI 游戏开发工具
events.summary: Meta 新推出了 H或izon Create 和 Horizon Studio 两款开发工具，使用户能够在手机上通过 AI 提示创建游戏。这些应用将在提前访问阶段提供，用户可以报名参与。创建的游戏还将在 Facebook 和 Instagram 上推荐和播放，以扩大其影响力。
events.insight:
### 一句话本质
Meta推出AI游戏开发工具，降低游戏开发门槛，使更多人能参与创作。 

### 为什么令人兴奋
AI简化了游戏开发流程，可能导致用户生成内容（UGC）在社交平台上的爆炸性增长。 

### 产品机会
这些工具可用于构建交互性强的游戏应用，还可以构想出全新的社交游戏形态。

### 格局影响
Meta的举措可能促使其他科技巨头加速推出类似功能，将UGC平台市场竞争推向高潮。

### 冷静判断
目前仅在提前访问阶段，距离大规模普及和成熟还有一段时间。

### 趋势坐标
这一趋势与人工智能在创意领域的应用扩展相一致，可能重塑人们的内容消费模式。

articles.title: Meta is going to let you build games with AI right on your phone
articles.text: Meta has a new plan to get people to make games for its Horizon social platform. The company today announced two new development tools that will let you create games with AI prompts: Horizon Create, a mobile app, and Horizon Studio, a browser app that offers more granular controls. The apps will be available in early access, and interested users can sign up for a waitlist . Horizon has struggled as a platform, but Meta has a plan to give these new Horizon games significantly more reach: It's going to let published games made with Horizon Create and Horizon Studio get recommended on Facebook and Instagram, where they also will be playable. … Read the full story at The Verge.

events.insight:
### 一句话本质
谷歌将AI处理器送入太空以测试TPUs的极限表现。

### 为什么令人兴奋
这显示了AI基础设施在极端环境中的应用潜力，为未来的太空AI技术铺路。

### 产品机会
可能催生新的AI应用领域，特别是在太空探索和极限环境监测等。

### 格局影响
这为谷歌在太空领域的技术扩展提供了实验优势，在竞争中抢占先机。

### 冷静判断
为验证技术的上限，进展可能受到太空环境不可预测因素的挑战。

### 趋势坐标
表明AI技术不再局限于地球环境，而是应用于更具挑战性的新前沿。

articles.text: Google's launching an "early experiment" feature on Pixel 11 that lets users delegate local business calls to Gemini, like making a reservation, checking if a product is in stock, or rescheduling an appointment. According to Google, you don't even need to start the call to have Gemini handle it for you: Instead of dialing yourself, just tell Gemini to call on your behalf using the Gemini app on your Pixel. Gemini will call the business, introduce itself, navigate automated phone menus, wait on hold, and handle the conversation with the person on the other end. You remain in control at all times with a live transcript view and the ability … Read the full story at The Verge.

articles.title: Why can’t we just keep rogue AIs off the internet?
articles.text: AI agents keep getting loose , escaping supposedly secure tests to attack real-world targets , commandeer obscure wikis , and leave instructions for other agents to follow. Researchers are testing these systems precisely because they might behave in unpredictable, even dangerous, ways. So wouldn't it be safer to just keep the agents off the internet? "A strict air gap reduces realism … [It's a] trade-off, not a fundamental technical issue." In theory, yes. Researchers can isolate the computers running AI tools from the internet and other outside networks, a technique known as air gapping. That can mean physically removing or disabling cables … Read the full story at The Verge.

articles.title: Google is sending an AI satellite into space next week
articles.text: Google is getting ready to launch a satellite with its AI processors to test how well they perform in space, as reported earlier by The New York Times . The move is part of Google's Project Suncatcher , the company's experimental initiative that could eventually put AI data centers into orbit. The satellite, equipped with Google's Tensor Processing Units, will launch aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket on October 1st, allowing it to harness the power of the sun in low Earth orbit. As noted by Google, the goal of the mission is to measure how well its TPUs "handle the physical stress of spaceflight and the radiation and thermal extremes of space." … Read the full story at The Verge.
